node.title: XR window-divisor maximality filter: predicate-filtered inversion and Bonferroni support moments
node.statement: For every predicate Pi of the uniquely reconstructed maximal pair, RAW_d^Pi=SUM_{e>=d} MAX_e^Pi*C(k+e,k+d), and finite binomial inversion recovers MAX_d^Pi. Its truncations satisfy the exact Bonferroni bounds S_(2a+1)^Pi(d)<=MAX_d^Pi<=S_(2a)^Pi(d). Thus maximality, selected liveness, and strip survival have an exact support-moment interface, but a closing use must control the signed sum as a whole. Raw affine-divisor counts remain inequivalent to SL-2, and full rank d of each single-word system does not imply joint codimension 2d.
